pages.title: Basic Protection Bypass
pages.text: Basic allows a master to attack their own maid normally, including with ordinary attacks and some firearms or ranged attacks. The maid takes damage and shows normal hit feedback.

pages.title: Protection Still Active
pages.text: Basic keeps the maid's invulnerability time, per-hit damage limits, death protection, armor, Resistance, and damage reduction active.

pages.title: Ultimate Protection Bypass
pages.text: Ultimate removes more protection and is intended for special gameplay that needs the full damage effect. Disabling Protection Bypass restores the normal damage rules between masters and maids.
